name: direct left open
speaker: Cole
line: Cole at Drydock, east roof. direct left open. 7 steps. The drum stays for the start.

speaker: Ada
line: Ada: Hold the drum at Drydock. Nobody past the east roof. We start in 8 steps. Direct on the left lane, open.

name: Drydock east roof
speaker: Bess
line: Drydock east roof. Bess keeps the drum for the start. 2 steps, direct on the left lane, open.
